sources.snippet: The vLLM recipe (../k2-horizon-32b-fp8/) is the faster way to run the 32B on two cards (66 tok/s on IFM's FP8 export vs 39-42 here on Q8_0, half the bytes per token); this lane exists for people who want a GGUF.

sources.title: K2 Horizon 32B - 524k context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-32B is the large dense K2 Horizon decoder-only model: 32B parameters, 512K native context, and Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face (IFM/K2-Horizon-32B). The published checkpoint is Stage 1 of final training; IFM notes Stage 2 results are forthcoming while releasing intermediate checkpoints openly.
